from matplotlib import pylab as pl
import numpy as np

def test():
    data = np.random.rand(6,6)
    fig = pl.figure(1)
    fig.clf()
    ax = fig.add_subplot(1,1,1)
    img = ax.imshow(data, interpolation='nearest', vmin=0.5, vmax=0.99)
    pl.colorbar(img, ax=ax)

    pl.show()
